beats.say: Halloween: The Game launched on modern consoles, but another spooky hero stole the show.
The title arrived on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X and Series S.
Yet Polygon recommends Luigi's Mansion 3 instead for family friendly seasonal fun.
Luigi's Mansion 3 is one of only two games in history to feature Gooigi.
That means while adults get gritty scares, everyone else gets gelatinous ghost busting.
